verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches this story indirectly. The SDK offers 'file management' and Datalab provides file storage for reuse across calls, which implies some control over stored files. Customers who need data privacy can run models on infrastructure they control, but only with an Enterprise contract. The Team plan lists a DPA. None of the evidence documents retention periods, auto-deletion, or an explicit delete operation for stored files, checkpoints, or job results. Missing for 10: documented retention policy/windows, explicit file/result deletion API or UI, checkpoint expiry controls, zero-retention option on the hosted API, independent corroboration.
